code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, LDH, D-dimer), and mild hypoalbuminemia. These findings suggest a significant inflammatory or infectious process, possibly with hypoxic respiratory involvement. No evidence of acute cardiac injury or significant liver/renal dysfunction. Recommend urgent clinical correlation and further evaluation for causes such as severe infection (e.g., COVID-19), sepsis, or other inflammatory conditions.
